IconCollection::loadIcons() hardcodes both the framework path (APP_INSTALL_FOLDER . '/themes/default/icons.json') and the custom path (APP_ROOT . '/themes/custom-icons.json') as inline string concatenations. These path constants are defined elsewhere and work, but extracting them into named constants or a configuration object would make the coupling explicit and easier to maintain.
